tools.name: search_beach_clubs
tools.description: Searches the BeachClubs.ae directory of beach clubs in the United Arab Emirates by name, hotel, area, emirate, family suitability, amenities and day pass price. Returns paginated club summaries with the BeachClubs.ae page link, a primary call-to-action link, price in AED (or a price-on-request note)

tools.name: get_beach_club
tools.description: Returns public details for one beach club in the United Arab Emirates, looked up by id or by name (typo tolerant): BeachClubs.ae page and primary call-to-action link, description, location, pricing options in AED (day passes, cabanas, packages), amenities, family suitability, policies and opening ho

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Lists published upcoming events at beach clubs in the United Arab Emirates (brunches, ladies' days, parties, live music) with Dubai local times, ticket prices and the BeachClubs.ae event page link. Paginated.

tools.name: request_booking_enquiry
tools.description: Sends a booking enquiry for a beach club in the United Arab Emirates to the BeachClubs.ae team, who reply to the guest by email. An enquiry is not a confirmed booking. Requires the guest's name, email, visit date, number of guests and acceptance of the BeachClubs.ae terms of service and privacy poli

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_events · Public sink: request_booking_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_events · Public sink: request_booking_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
